nodes.label: decisions.md
nodes.rationale: Persistent decision log recording one line per shipped task with one-clause rationale.

nodes.label: PM Workflow Visibility
nodes.rationale: Hybrid visibility (inputs committed, generated artifacts local-only) mirrors SahurHub, allowing contributors to scaffold locally without repository clutter.

nodes.label: Gemini Model Selection
nodes.rationale: Selected gemini-3.5-flash-lite over 3.1-flash-lite as GA successor, verified available and responsive on the free tier.

nodes.label: Local Graphify Knowledge Graph
nodes.rationale: Graphify knowledge graph is local-only and gitignored because in a solo workspace there is no value in committing a regenerable graph.

nodes.label: Documentation Hygiene TitleCase
nodes.rationale: Enforces TitleCase for headings, table headers, and bullet labels per AGENTS.md Documentation Hygiene for cross-repo consistency.

nodes.label: Lint and Format Split
nodes.rationale: Split Biome as linter only and Prettier as formatter to avoid mass-reformatting of Prettier-styled codebase while matching SahurHub tooling.

nodes.label: Conventional Commits Policy
nodes.rationale: Enforces Conventional Commits locally via commitlint and husky hooks matching SahurHub configuration.

nodes.label: Formatting Ownership
nodes.rationale: Biome owns formatting, linting, and import sorting for TS/JS, while Prettier formats md/yml/json after human accepted one-time reformat.

nodes.label: Phase 9 Turn Reliability
nodes.rationale: Retries are rate-aware and bounded (liveMaxRetries=2, ~12s backoff ceiling, floors 2/3); drops same-channel messages with busy reply; sessions destroyed on terminal errors only.

nodes.label: Phase 10 Dev Workspace Hybrid Harness
nodes.rationale: Hybrid harness in test/harness/ with headless transcript driver in npm test; fake-LLM default via test seam in roka.ts; --live uses GRAPHIFY_GEMINI_API_KEY.

nodes.label: Phase 11 Tool Suite Trimming and Prompt Diet
nodes.rationale: LLM tool suite trimmed to anime, search_web, reminders, memory; conservative prompt diet kept personality intact; extraction tuned to buffer 30/interval 20/gap 20s.
nodes.norm_label: phase 11 tool suite trimming and prompt diet

nodes.label: Phase 12 SQLite Observability Metrics
nodes.rationale: Metrics live in SQLite (response_events/extraction_events, 90-day retention) via never-throw handlers; spans mirror harness stage names (e2e/generate/llm); shared token estimator.

nodes.label: Buddy Sprites Generation and CDN Hosting
nodes.rationale: Buddy sprite CDN URLs hardcoded in buddySpecies.ts following expressions.ts precedent; local PNGs regenerated via scripts/optimize-sprites.ts with 96px pixelation.
nodes.norm_label: buddy sprites generation and cdn hosting

nodes.label: Sharp Multi-Stage Resize Pipeline
nodes.rationale: Sharp only applies one .resize() per pipeline; must materialize with toBuffer() between distinct resize stages.

nodes.label: Buddy Sprite Hosting Migration
nodes.rationale: Buddy sprite hosting migrated from catbox.moe to postimages.org direct URLs after catbox 0-byte outage; 18 local PNGs remain source of truth.

nodes.label: Prompt Injection Defense and Memory Chokepoint
nodes.rationale: Structural inertness via labelled untrusted-JSON envelope is primary defense; scalar validation is defense-in-depth; all fact writes funnel through saveFact chokepoint.
nodes.norm_label: prompt injection defense and memory chokepoint

nodes.label: Buddy Table Unique Constraint Drop
nodes.rationale: Dropped legacy buddy UNIQUE(user_id) constraint via schema table rebuild to support daily-hatch collection growth as confirmed product intent.

nodes.label: Slash Commands Dev Guild Registration
nodes.rationale: Optional DISCORD_DEV_GUILD_ID switches command registration to guild route for instant dev propagation; global route unchanged when unset.

nodes.label: Game Countdown Timers Configuration
nodes.rationale: Hangman and shiritori countdown displays derive dynamically from configured timeout (set to 120000 ms per in-game guide) rather than hardcoded +60s.

nodes.label: Gacha Rolling 24h Hatch Cadence
nodes.rationale: Hatch gate is rolling 24h via last_hatch_at timestamp with streak continuing if previous hatch <= 48h, avoiding timezone math with one timestamp source of truth.

nodes.label: Gacha Collection Components V2 UI
nodes.rationale: /gacha collection is a separate paginated Components-v2 subcommand with per-reply user-scoped collectors; /gacha stats stays aggregate without global button router.

nodes.label: Phase 14 Claims Memory Backend Dormant Ship
nodes.rationale: Claims memory backend shipped behind config.memory.claimsBackend (default false) with dual-write warming; legacy zero-attestation facts skipped at backfill.
nodes.norm_label: phase 14 claims memory backend dormant ship

nodes.label: Task 91 Claims Backend Default Promotion
nodes.rationale: Promoted claims memory backend to default-on globally after shadow eval and live voice check without per-guild canary; single-process Pi deployment made canary plumbing unjustified.

nodes.label: Documentation Restructure README and TRD
nodes.rationale: docs/README.md is front door (setup/usage/how-to) and docs/trd.md holds technical reference; features appear at different altitudes, never duplicated verbatim.

nodes.label: CodeRabbit CI PR Gate
nodes.rationale: Main branch is PR-only requiring CodeRabbit check (ruleset 19584734, no bypass actors); pr-auto polls terminal state with 60-min window where missing/rate-limited does not equal success.

nodes.label: CodeRabbit Gate Unwind Procedure
nodes.rationale: To drop CodeRabbit: delete ruleset 19584734 first to prevent blocking merges, uninstall app, remove .coderabbit.yaml, and revert AGENTS.md/roles.md pr-auto language.

nodes.label: Roka Voice and Kaomoji Guidelines
nodes.rationale: Roka response length target 50-70 words with maxOutputTokens 500 as headroom; facial emoji banned in favor of kaomoji-only, with decorative/symbol emoji permitted.

nodes.label: Tone Expression Variety and Detector Rebalance
nodes.rationale: Per-tone avoid-immediate-repeat with injectable RNG; detector rebalance narrowed annoyed to explicit phrasings and set curious priority 3, validated by live checks.
nodes.norm_label: tone expression variety and detector rebalance

nodes.label: CodeRabbit Rate Limit Review Handling
nodes.rationale: Rate-limited reviews post success STATE even when failing commit status; merge procedure must check status DESCRIPTION, allowing overrides only by explicit human authorization.

nodes.label: Command Architecture and Tool Disclosure Footer
nodes.rationale: Utilities run as implicit ADK tools under Roka-as-agent while slash menu carries conversation/games/stats; tool invocations disclose via -# 🌸 footer (labels only).
nodes.norm_label: command architecture and tool disclosure footer

nodes.label: Slash Command Consolidation Layout A
nodes.rationale: Shipped Layout A schedule merge while deferring Layout B (guide/leaderboard dedup) to combine with game-tables guild_id migration into one breaking change.

nodes.label: README Operator Abstraction
nodes.rationale: README documents general assumptions only, omitting operator-specific Pi deployment details like IPs, absolute paths, disk stats, or Tailscale configuration.

nodes.label: Phase 17 Layout B and Guild ID Migration Declined
nodes.rationale: Declined Layout B and guild_id migration because 8-command menu and cross-server /stats are sufficient; accepted leaderboard/guide duplication as-is.
nodes.norm_label: phase 17 layout b and guild id migration declined

nodes.label: Memory Privacy and Guild Isolation
nodes.rationale: Predicate categories may surface in /stats teasers but fact values never; guild isolation made absolute by dropping 'global' fallback in getFacts, keeping DM facts DM-only.

nodes.label: /stats Redesign Specifications
nodes.rationale: Fixed 30D window (12M heatmap exception), Tailwind-style skeleton, no kaomoji on stats, ROKA_CHART_PALETTE degree gradients, tone accent donuts, zero-LLM mood label.

nodes.label: Response Events Tools Used Logging
nodes.rationale: tools_used is persisted on response_events as a JSON array string containing tool names only without arguments, accruing counts from deploy forward.

nodes.label: Codex Worker Briefs Interactive Features Pre-Decline
nodes.rationale: Codex briefs must explicitly pre-decline optional interactive features to avoid wasted runs drifting into unrequested features like visual companions.
nodes.norm_label: codex worker briefs interactive features pre-decline

nodes.label: Chart Rendering Container Font Parity
nodes.rationale: Chart rendering requires font-dejavu and fontconfig baked into Alpine runtime image; canvas output must be verified in-container under preview parity rule.

nodes.label: /stats Headers and Bot Self-Exclusion
nodes.rationale: Plain view headers with '-# Last 30 Days'; server mood is rendered as a stat line; bot's own user ID is excluded from all memory-facing statistics.

nodes.label: /stats Memory Quote Top-Salience Privacy Amendment
nodes.rationale: Human-directed privacy amendment: memory quote surfaces top-salience claim VALUE in-guild (excluding needs_review, capped at 60 chars); all other stats remain value-free.

nodes.label: Historical Stats Backfill Declined
nodes.rationale: Declined historical stats backfill because session_history is a pruned FIFO without archive; stats history accrues from 2026-07-22 forward.

nodes.label: Lint Verification Direct Biome Fallback
nodes.rationale: Run Biome directly when RTK's lint filter produces errors, as RTK parse failures can mask genuine formatting violations.

nodes.label: Gemini Function Call Ordering 400 Recovery
nodes.rationale: Gemini function-call-ordering 400 treated as recoverable session_corrupt kind: destroy session, rehydrate from SQLite, and retry once, deflecting only on recovery failure.

nodes.label: Memory Recall Freshest-First Bounded Retrieval
nodes.rationale: Memory recall is freshest-first bounded to 15 facts; recall-touch applies only to surfaced claims; /stats quote pick blends recency into salience.

nodes.label: Phase 19 Steered Safety Regeneration
nodes.rationale: Supersedes static deflection: safety gets ONE steered in-character regeneration via AsyncLocalStorage in orchestrator before falling to static line without blind re-rolls, consuming RPM token.

nodes.label: Gemini Safety Settings Explicit OFF Configuration
nodes.rationale: safetySettings configured explicitly at gemini.safetyThreshold (default OFF) across all 3 call sites to avoid unstable per-model defaults; HARM_BLOCK_THRESHOLD_UNSPECIFIED is rejected.
nodes.norm_label: gemini safety settings explicit off configuration

nodes.label: Failure Marker Raw Token Cap and Privacy
nodes.rationale: response_events.failure_marker stores only raw errorCode/finishReason token capped at 64 chars, never errorMessage, preventing user request content echoing into persisted storage.
nodes.norm_label: failure marker raw token cap and privacy

nodes.label: Phase 20 Turn Deadline Admission Control
nodes.rationale: Retry loop bounded by gemini.turnDeadlineMs via admission control: retries require remaining budget >= requestTimeoutMs, attempt 0 never gated; per-attempt clamping rejected to avoid orphaned runs.

nodes.label: Digit-Anchored HTTP Status Failure Classification
nodes.rationale: HTTP status codes digit-anchored and demoted below symbolic markers in classifyGeminiFailure to prevent bare numerics in bodies (e.g. 4000000 in 429) misclassifying as terminal.

nodes.label: Retry Backoff Cap Dual Purpose
nodes.rationale: config.gemini.retryBackoffCapMs deliberately serves as both cumulative ceiling and computeBackoff per-attempt maxMs to keep pre-jitter range consistent with the ceiling.

nodes.label: Pattern Matching Fixes Mutation Pinning Rule
nodes.rationale: Regression tests for pattern matching must be pinned by mutation: strip behavior, confirm failure, restore; green suites can pass for the wrong reason due to earlier fixture short-circuits.
nodes.norm_label: pattern matching fixes mutation pinning rule

nodes.label: PR #36 CodeRabbit Gate Human Override
nodes.rationale: PR #36 merged with CodeRabbit overridden by human authorization after rate-limited review hollow pass; substantiated by 4 independent QA passes with mutation probes; remains a STOP condition.

nodes.label: Codex Worker Briefs Self-Contained Requirement
nodes.rationale: Codex briefs must inline issue text instead of citing gh issue numbers because api.github.com is unreachable from Codex sandboxes, preventing failed runs.

nodes.label: Codex Sandbox Network Access Flag
nodes.rationale: Codex workspace-write has network access off by default; tasks requiring network must explicitly opt in with -c sandbox_workspace_write.network_access=true.

nodes.label: Codex Worker AGENTS.md PM Lock Preamble
nodes.rationale: Worker briefs require a preamble clarifying the worker is dispatched by the PM and unconstrained by docs/.pm-lock, preventing workers from refusing tasks by over-applying PM rules.
nodes.norm_label: codex worker agents.md pm lock preamble

nodes.label: Codex Output Files Outside Repo
nodes.rationale: Codex -o outfile artifacts must be written outside repo (scratchpad) rather than docs/.codex/ to avoid Biome parsing prose with .json extension as invalid JSON and failing lint.

nodes.label: Live Model Behavior Third Test Gate
nodes.rationale: Added npm run test:live as 3rd gate distinct from offline correctness (npm test) and latency (test:perf); prevents network hiccups from masking as correctness/perf regressions.
nodes.norm_label: live model behavior third test gate

nodes.label: Live Model Statistical Verdict
nodes.rationale: Live-model gate asserts statistical verdict (accuracy floor + 0 systematic failures) rather than per-case majority voting which flakes ~22% at temp 0.9; thresholds measured from calibration.

nodes.label: Statistical Gate Pure Scorer Data Mutation Pin
nodes.rationale: Mutation pin applied as synthetic broken-bot data to a pure scorer module to assert verdict flips, running automatically in default offline gate on every run.
nodes.norm_label: statistical gate pure scorer data mutation pin

nodes.label: Verdict Thresholds Shared Registry and Predicate
nodes.rationale: Live gate verdict thresholds defined in one exported constant and predicate shared with offline pin to prevent silent desync during recalibration.
nodes.norm_label: verdict thresholds shared registry and predicate

nodes.label: Live Benchmark Abort on Non-Ok Turns
nodes.rationale: Live benchmarks abort immediately on non-ok metrics.outcome to avoid rate-limited or deflected fallback turns falsely scoring as no-fires and distorting accuracy.
nodes.norm_label: live benchmark abort on non-ok turns

nodes.label: Live Eval Fixture World Collision Avoidance
nodes.rationale: Retriever FTS matches message terms against claim values; case messages must not share tokens with seeded world claims to avoid unintended prompt pollution.
nodes.norm_label: live eval fixture world collision avoidance

nodes.label: Live Benchmark RPM Pacing Headroom
nodes.rationale: Benchmark pacing set by RPM with headroom (12s interval = 10 RPM for 2 calls/turn against 15 cap); prevents 429s from corrupting measurement integrity.

nodes.label: Ship Red on Real Defect Policy
nodes.rationale: Gates detecting real defects ship red with filed defects referenced in docs; relabelling cases or lowering thresholds to manufacture green is forbidden.
nodes.norm_label: ship red on real defect policy

nodes.label: Live Tool Trigger Gate Aggregate Floors
nodes.rationale: Live tool gate asserts aggregate precision >= 0.80 and recall >= 0.80 across 18 observations instead of noisy per-case trials; floors set to target behavior via Binomial convolution.
nodes.norm_label: live tool trigger gate aggregate floors

nodes.label: Recall User Proactive Trigger Current Message Scoping
nodes.rationale: recall_user trigger scoped strictly to current message to eliminate false positives (70% of FPs) caused by model reaching for names in older channel history.
nodes.norm_label: recall user proactive trigger current message scoping

nodes.label: NUMERIC_BOUNDS Single Registry
nodes.rationale: NUMERIC_BOUNDS in config.ts is the single registry for all 46 numeric tunables, validating min/max and finite values in loop; notes maxLlmCalls<=0 unbounded and contextSize:0 whole buffer.

nodes.label: Turn Deadline Budget Max-Jitter Derivation
nodes.rationale: Turn-deadline budget derived via max-jitter formula, enforced at build time by CI tests and via logger.warn at runtime to prevent Pi restart crash loops.

nodes.label: Turn Deadline Default Raised to 63000ms
nodes.rationale: Raised turnDeadlineMs from 60000 to 63000 rather than reducing calibrated timeout 20000 (p95 9801ms), adhering to principle that policy numbers move before measured calibrations.

nodes.label: Separate Max Live Retry Window and Reachability Formulas
nodes.rationale: maxLiveRetryWindow (duration tail vs session TTL) and requiredMs (reachability tail vs turn deadline) remain separate formulas to prevent forcing checks onto the wrong tail.
nodes.norm_label: separate max live retry window and reachability formulas

nodes.label: Transient Status 504 Classification Addition
nodes.rationale: Added 504 to transient status codes; unobserved codes (502/408) left unfiled until observed in production, following measured-not-invented principle.

nodes.label: Achievable Retry Attempt Count Derivation
nodes.rationale: Declined flat aggregate backoff cap because it went silent at R>=5; guard must derive achievable attempt count dynamically based on deadline and jitter.

nodes.label: Components V2 TextDisplay 4000 Character Ceiling
nodes.rationale: Discord reply ceiling is 4000 chars via Components V2 TextDisplay (setting MessageFlags.IsComponentsV2) instead of standard content 2000-char limit.

nodes.label: Reminder Stale Threshold Inclusive Comparison
nodes.rationale: Reminder stale guard uses <= instead of < because startReminderScheduler has no leading tick and sweeps downtime due items on startup after frequent deploys.

nodes.label: Cross-Key Config Checks Warning Without Clamping
nodes.rationale: Cross-key config checks issue warnings without clamping; clamping memory.contextSize is unobservable since .slice(-N) returns entire buffer when N exceeds length.
nodes.norm_label: cross-key config checks warning without clamping

nodes.label: PR #62 CodeRabbit Comment-Only Diff Human Waiver
nodes.rationale: Human waived rate-limited CodeRabbit pass on final comment-only commit because substantive diff was fully reviewed in earlier commit.
nodes.norm_label: pr #62 coderabbit comment-only diff human waiver

nodes.label: GitHub PR Checks Explicit Presence Polling
nodes.rationale: gh pr checks loop must poll explicitly for check presence rather than only checking absence of pending, which falsely treats unregistered checks as terminal.
nodes.norm_label: github pr checks explicit presence polling

nodes.label: Group Conversation Roster Rejection
nodes.rationale: Rejected group conversation roster: naming earlier chatters severely regressed tool recall (1.000 -> 0.389) by conflicting with core.ts:65 current-message scoping.

nodes.label: Prompt Addition Recall Regression Principle
nodes.rationale: Prompt changes can regress tool triggering through recall rather than only precision; contingency levers must be measured against real failures, not predicted ones.

nodes.label: Documentation Constraints Existence vs Value Rule
nodes.rationale: Docs state that a constraint exists and where it is enforced, never its value; concrete values live in code constants pinned by tests to prevent silent drift.
nodes.norm_label: documentation constraints existence vs value rule

nodes.label: AGENTS.md Data Models Section Deletion
nodes.rationale: Deleted AGENTS.md Key Data Models section because docs/trd.md is canonical and redundant summaries in AGENTS.md had drifted.

nodes.label: Request Composition Prose Enumeration Avoidance
nodes.rationale: Exhaustive prose enumeration of request composition avoided due to documentation rot risk; implementation code remains sole pin.

nodes.label: MAX_SYSTEM_PROMPT_TOKENS Catastrophe Rail
nodes.rationale: MAX_SYSTEM_PROMPT_TOKENS (5000) acts as catastrophe rail permitting ~66% growth over measured worst case (~3,023), not a latency constraint.

nodes.label: ToneKey Table Test Pinning
nodes.rationale: docs/trd.md ToneKey table pinned by test asserting equality to Object.keys(TONE_PROMPTS) after unpinned docs drifted to 8 of 12 tones.

nodes.label: Retry Budget Dual Jitter Tails
nodes.rationale: Deadline budget uses MAX jitter for guarantee check, whereas cap-reachability warning uses MIN jitter to avoid false claims that an attempt count is impossible.

nodes.label: Reliability Guard Test Loop Binding
nodes.rationale: Reliability guard tied to loop by testing real runTurnWithReliability across maxRetries 0-6; previous prose-modeled fixes all drifted and failed.

nodes.label: Failure Marker Closed HTTP Status Allowlist
nodes.rationale: failure_marker persists HTTP status from closed allowlist (400|401|403|429|500|503|504); the allowlist rather than digit-anchoring prevents echoing request content.
nodes.norm_label: failure marker closed http status allowlist

nodes.label: Discord Max Message Length Derived Ceiling
nodes.rationale: discord.maxMessageLength ceiling derived as 4000 - MAX_TOOL_FOOTER_CHARS from TOOL_USAGE_LABELS (3878), preventing unsendable messages when tools fire.
nodes.norm_label: discord max message length derived ceiling

nodes.label: Tone Precedence First-Match-Wins and Freezing
nodes.rationale: Tone precedence is first-match-wins pinned by test; TONE_PATTERNS is kept frozen without reordering because any prompt shift requires costly live re-measurement.

nodes.label: AGENTS.md General Guidelines and No Build Pin
nodes.rationale: AGENTS.md carries general guidelines only without build-time pins once concrete numeric values were removed, avoiding brittle doc-parsing test pins.
nodes.norm_label: agents.md general guidelines and no build pin

nodes.label: Serial Mutation Probes Process
nodes.rationale: Mutation probes break shared source and cause false failures in concurrent workers; must run serially in a single task after parallel waves complete.

nodes.label: Per-Channel DM Memory Tenancy Isolation
nodes.rationale: Every non-guild channel assigned own tenant dm:${channelId}, closing DM-to-DM cross-read privacy flaw; legacy 'global' facts prune out naturally without migration.

nodes.label: Memory Tools Fail Closed on Missing Tenant State
nodes.rationale: Memory tools fail closed on absent-or-'global' tenant state with structured WARN log, rather than defaulting to 'global', distinguishing genuine empty recall from failed tenant state.
nodes.norm_label: memory tools fail closed on missing tenant state

nodes.label: Capturing Runner Pattern
nodes.rationale: Capturing-Runner pattern is the correct pin point to observe tenant reaching ADK; __setTestRunTurnFactory sits above runner.runAsync and structurally cannot observe tenant propagation.

nodes.label: Security Mutation Review Rule
nodes.rationale: Security fix regression tests must be verified by probing what mutation reopens the vulnerability while the suite stays green, rather than by reading test code.

nodes.label: Isolated It Block Assertion Convention
nodes.rationale: Mutation probe target assertions must sit in their own it block because Vitest stops at the first failure in a block, allowing coarser checks to mask specific probe assertions.

nodes.label: Game Command Guild Restriction Rationale
nodes.rationale: Games (/hangman, /shiritori) remain Guild-only because timeout-completion pushes out-of-band to channel, failing without channel access; /gacha is user-installable.

nodes.label: Command Registration Policy by Pointer
nodes.rationale: Installation and context policy is documented by pointer to registration.test.ts asserting real buildCommandBody(); uses sorted array comparison to catch duplicate command names.

nodes.label: User Install Context Policy
nodes.rationale: No offline test pins user-install execution because Discord enforces command contexts, making runtime guards unreachable branches; ready.ts catches rejected PUTs.

nodes.label: Attempt Timed Out Retry Mechanism
nodes.rationale: attemptTimedOut flag distinguishes transient request timeout from shutdown/deadline aborts, allowing timed-out attempts to fall through to retry budgeting.

nodes.label: AbortController Swap on Timed Out Retry
nodes.rationale: Backoff sleep swaps in fresh AbortController on attempt timeout so the attempt's aborted signal does not cancel the retry delay, while shutdown still cuts sleep short.
nodes.norm_label: abortcontroller swap on timed out retry

nodes.label: Safety De-escalation Ladder
nodes.rationale: Three-rung ladder ('drop_overheard', 'drop_facts', 'clear_history') sheds optional context per retry to mitigate non-adjustable PROHIBITED_CONTENT blocks.

nodes.label: Safety Rehydration Suppression
nodes.rationale: Safety rung 3 adds channel to rehydrationSuppressed on session destroy to prevent re-importing contaminated SQLite history upon session recreation.

nodes.label: Safety Retry Token Gating
nodes.rationale: Retry tokens are consumed only if extraSafetyAttempts < safetyLadderLength to prevent wasting RPM retry tokens when the safety de-escalation ladder is exhausted.

nodes.label: Failure Diagnostics Table
nodes.rationale: failure_diagnostics table stores raw triggering messages with short retention (metrics.diagnosticsRetentionHours=72) and distinguishes prompt vs response block_side.

nodes.label: Reply Split Bound Derivation
nodes.rationale: discord.maxMessageLength bound is documented by naming the code enforcement point, pinned to 4000 - MAX_TOOL_FOOTER_CHARS rather than hardcoding numbers.

nodes.label: Split Response Midpoint Heuristic
nodes.rationale: splitResponse takes the last newline > halfway mark, else last space > halfway, else hard cut; sentence-boundary splitting is rejected as inaccurate.

nodes.label: Guild Permissions Derivation Documentation
nodes.rationale: Guild permissions documented as operation-to-permission derivations without line numbers; static grep tests rejected as pinning code against grep rather than Portal.

nodes.label: Reminder Channel First Delivery
nodes.rationale: reminderScheduler delivers to originating channel first, falling back to user DM only when channel is unreachable, requiring guild Send Messages permission.

nodes.label: Claim Salience Ranking Preservation
nodes.rationale: recall_user preserves getActiveClaims ordering (pinned, salience, last_seen_at, id) up to 15 slots without re-sorting by lastSeenAt, protecting explicit facts from eviction.

nodes.label: Uniform Predicate Salience Model
nodes.rationale: baseSalience is hardcoded to 0.5 across all predicates; salience varies only by sourceKind and observation count, leaving predicate importance unmodelled.

nodes.label: User By Name Tenant Filtering
nodes.rationale: findUserByName filters by tenant across memory_claim, user_memory, and response_events to prevent cross-tenant identity leakage on recall_user.

nodes.label: ADK Runner Contract Test Isolation
nodes.rationale: ADK contract test instantiates dedicated Runner and LlmAgent instances to verify state delta propagation without disturbing harness mock seams.

nodes.label: Direct Messages Intent Omission Growth Barrier
nodes.rationale: Zero dm-prefixed tenants exist because client.ts omits DirectMessages intent; DM tenants only spawn via slash commands, keeping memory database growth structurally slow.
nodes.norm_label: direct messages intent omission growth barrier

nodes.label: CodeRabbit OSS Review Behavior
nodes.rationale: CodeRabbit free OSS tier reports green status on skipped or rate-limited checks; manual @coderabbitai review required for real review.

nodes.label: Parallel Worktree PM Peer Protocol
nodes.rationale: Parallel agent workflows use separate git worktrees with disjoint file scopes; peers refuse relayed authorizations for production-touching merges.

nodes.label: Tavily Search Quality Repair
nodes.rationale: Preserved Tavily by removing geo-poisoning query timestamps and upgrading include_answer from basic to advanced to eliminate hallucinated Amazon AI identities.

nodes.label: Search Depth and Synthesis Layering
nodes.rationale: search_depth governs sources retrieved while include_answer governs synthesis; both set to advanced because include_answer adds zero credit cost.

nodes.label: Search Recency Handling Limitation
nodes.rationale: Tavily days and time_range filters degraded news queries by dropping older context; per-call recency deferred to schema and tool description changes.

nodes.label: NSFW Search Domain Policy
nodes.rationale: No domain exclusion list applied to search results because bot is deployed to NSFW servers; any future filter should key on Discord NSFW channel flag.

nodes.label: Positive-Only Search Rubric
nodes.rationale: Proactive search prompt uses positive-only triggers; negative rules (Never search...) make banned categories salient to the model and cause false triggers.

nodes.label: Harness Trial Pacing Guard
nodes.rationale: TRIAL_PACING_MS enforces a raise-only 12000ms minimum to prevent 429 quota exhaustion against Gemini free-tier RPM limits under retry ladders.

nodes.label: Harness Timeout Pacing Derivation
nodes.rationale: vitest.live.config.ts testTimeout dynamically derives from pacing to prevent premature harness timeouts from masking benchmark results.

nodes.label: Swept Budget Invariant Testing
nodes.rationale: Budget invariants must be tested via swept inputs rather than sampled worst-cases to detect off-by-one errors on precise boundary fillings.

nodes.label: Biome noDelete Undefined Coercion Hazard
nodes.rationale: Biome noDelete autofix converts delete process.env.X to = undefined, which string-coerces to truthy 'undefined' and bypasses apiKey presence guards.

nodes.label: UTF-16 Emoji Surrogate Split Protection
nodes.rationale: splitResponse steps back from trailing high surrogates to prevent splitting UTF-16 emoji pairs into invalid lone replacement characters.

nodes.label: Production Shape Sweep Testing Convention
nodes.rationale: Swept tests must draw input shapes from actual bot production output (emoji, kaomoji, special characters) rather than convenient ASCII fixtures.

nodes.label: Ask Command Consolidation
nodes.rationale: Retired /chat and /search in favor of unified /ask; accepted trade-off of eliminating zero-Gemini direct search path when model is unavailable.

nodes.label: Search Citation Pipeline Migration
nodes.rationale: Migrated citation renderer from retired /search to /ask and mention reply paths using AsyncLocalStorage toolCallsForRequest sink.

nodes.label: Command Set API Verification
nodes.rationale: Command registration verified directly via Discord API GET endpoint because deploy logs mask rejected command PUT errors.

nodes.label: Tight Tool Footer Chars Bound
nodes.rationale: MAX_TOOL_FOOTER_CHARS is tightly swept at 122 chars, relying on generateResponse deduplicating toolsUsed into a Set to prevent overrunning message limits.

nodes.label: Prompt Layer Recency Precedence
nodes.rationale: Later prompt layers win on recency; SPEECH_PROMPT style quotas override CORE_PROMPT rules unless style rules are explicitly scoped off searched turns.

nodes.label: Speech Quota Roleplay Scoping
nodes.rationale: Kaomoji and teasing quotas in SPEECH_PROMPT scoped off searched turns to prevent model from manufacturing unwanted trailing roleplay paragraphs.

nodes.label: Unconditional Prompt Assembly Architecture
nodes.rationale: promptAssembler executes before model runs and cannot know if tools will fire, requiring all tool-handling instructions to be unconditional.

nodes.label: Gemini Project Quota Isolation
nodes.rationale: GEMINI_API_KEY and GRAPHIFY_GEMINI_API_KEY reside in separate Google Cloud projects, ensuring live gate testing does not exhaust production bot quotas.

nodes.label: Search Web Tool Scoped Prompt Rules
nodes.rationale: Searched-turn instructions scoped specifically to search_web rather than all tools to avoid stripping persona from dice-rolling or coin-flipping turns.
nodes.norm_label: search web tool scoped prompt rules

nodes.label: CodeRabbit Standing Merge Waiver
nodes.rationale: Operator established policy to merge without waiting on CodeRabbit reviews due to low repo stars skipping automated reviews.

nodes.label: Published Branch Rebase Ban
nodes.rationale: Rebasing published branches is strictly prohibited; git merge origin/main must be used after first push because remote tracking refs can be stale.

nodes.label: CodeRabbit Verdict Phrase Detection
nodes.rationale: Review detection checks for explicit verdict phrases rather than empty review arrays or file-list comment greps which yield false positives on rate limits.

nodes.label: CodeRabbit Account Slot Protocol
nodes.rationale: One review per rolling hour is shared across the entire account; code PRs take priority over docs-only PRs for triggering review slots.

nodes.label: Memory Consent Split Architecture
nodes.rationale: Memory claims split by consent: direct user requests produce explicit claims that auto-pin against maxActiveClaimsPerUser, while extractor handles passive trivia.

nodes.label: Privacy Guard Loose Floor
nodes.rationale: privacyGuard blocks credentials and contact info while allowing general facts; throws exact message 'Claim value is unsafe' so background extractor skips safely.

nodes.label: Flat Image Token Cost
nodes.rationale: Gemini 3.5 Flash Lite bills square images at a flat 1089 tokens regardless of resolution, overturning tile-based models and making 512px upscaling token-neutral.

nodes.label: Post-Turn Attachment Stripping
nodes.rationale: Attachment bytes stripped from session events after turn completion, preventing ~11.5 MB memory retention per attachment from reaching the 560MB V8 container limit.

nodes.label: Modality-Decoupled Token Cost
nodes.rationale: Token cost is decoupled from byte size across modalities (PDF 560/page, audio 32/s, video 91/s), meaning byte caps cannot bound TPM consumption.

nodes.label: Media Byte Prefix Ingestion
nodes.rationale: Oversized media ingested using raw byte prefixes via HTTP Range requests without transcoding, avoiding ffmpeg dependencies and CPU load inside the turn.

nodes.label: Wiring vs Logic Guard Probing
nodes.rationale: Guards must be verified by probing their actual wiring (deleting call sites, inverting seams) because logic tests can drift from production paths while staying green.

nodes.label: Attachment TPM RPM Divergence
nodes.rationale: Attachment-heavy turns consume up to 55k tokens, causing RPM rate limits to exceed TPM quotas by 334% and requiring separate token budget tracking.

nodes.label: Live Gate Transient Fallback Retries
nodes.rationale: Live gate retries transient fallbacks up to 3 times on fresh channels while aborting immediately on deflections, separating flaky network/empty errors from trigger bugs.

nodes.label: Live Gate Hour Pinning
nodes.rationale: Harness pins local hour during live gate runs to prevent time-of-day prompt transitions (05:00 UTC early morning) from confounding A/B benchmark comparisons.

nodes.label: Fine-Grained Evidence Rule
nodes.rationale: Prefer the finest-grained evidence already available (per-trial over per-run) and verify who chose comparison boundaries before accepting clean results.

nodes.label: Surgical Mutation Probe Discipline
nodes.rationale: Mutation probes must be surgical to avoid accidentally modifying multiple constants together and masking predicted test failures.

nodes.label: Complementary Config Test Split
nodes.rationale: Config testing requires two complementary tests: derive what states a relationship (formula drift), and write out explicit literals that must not change quietly.

nodes.label: Sliding Window Rate Limiting
nodes.rationale: Rate limiter uses exact sliding window while tokenBudget uses halved window, implementing the principle of exact where cheap and halved where not.

nodes.label: CI Terminal State Verdict Check
nodes.rationale: Merge discipline requires explicitly checking the CI check verdict for pass or skipping, refusing merges on pending completion alone.

nodes.label: Environment-Independent Test Derivation
nodes.rationale: Tests must state relative relationships like (clock + 1) % 24 rather than literal environment values to avoid failing under different machine timezones.

nodes.label: Artifact-Anchored Test Assertion
nodes.rationale: Assertions must anchor on exact emitted artifacts or hardcoded constants (e.g. MAX_ATTACHMENTS === 1) rather than proximity strings or comments.

nodes.label: In-Flight Hold Assertion Principle
nodes.rationale: When a feature reserves capacity during an operation, tests must assert state during the hold; post-completion checks cannot see peak reservation.

nodes.label: Document Change Synchronization
nodes.rationale: Documentation updates must describe the world that concurrent in-flight behavior changes will leave behind, rather than fixing docs for code about to change.

nodes.label: Native Timer Seam Limitation
nodes.rationale: Node native AbortSignal.timeout bypasses Vitest fake timers; bound tests must assert on the timeout constant rather than relying on un-interceptable timers.

nodes.label: Formatter Concurrency Awareness
nodes.rationale: Treat code formatters as concurrent writers: assert match counts on every replacement script to catch reformatted import blocks and targets.

nodes.label: Surprise vs Fault Discriminator
nodes.rationale: Surprise is not evidence of a defect; if the healthy architectural mechanism explains the probe result, the test result is valid and expectation was wrong.

nodes.label: Representative Specimen Control Principle
nodes.rationale: Varying methods while holding an unrepresentative specimen constant replicates false conclusions; test specimens must represent real production media.

nodes.label: CountTokens Video Audio Bias Balance
nodes.rationale: countTokens over-reports video at 103/s vs MEDIA_RESOLUTION_LOW billing at 64/s, offsetting audio estimation gaps; allowance deleted since estimator already over-charges.

nodes.label: Group Conversation Roster Removal
nodes.rationale: Group conversation participant roster removed from production prompt after paired A/B testing showed multi-speaker accumulation degraded model recall to 0.722.

nodes.label: Session State Fixture Seeding
nodes.rationale: Harness test fixture headers support sessionState seeding, enabling evaluation of multi-turn conversational states previously invisible to fresh-channel tests.

nodes.label: Send Path Markdown Backtick Escaping
nodes.rationale: Backtick escaping implemented in responses.ts send path rather than prompt to reliably prevent kaomoji backticks from forming broken markdown code spans.

nodes.label: Gemini-Overload Fallback Model
nodes.rationale: ModelScope Qwen/Qwen3.5-122B-A10B configured with thinking disabled as Gemini overload fallback, matching Gemini Flash Lite zero thought tokens.

nodes.label: Discord Gateway Layer
nodes.rationale: discord.js v14 client handling /ask slash command, mention/reply detection, rate limit guard, concurrency guard, and typing indicators.

nodes.label: Per-Channel Concurrency Guard
nodes.rationale: Enforces exactly 1 active request per channel; concurrent incoming requests in a busy channel are rejected with an in-character busy reply.

nodes.label: Session Manager Hot Cache
nodes.rationale: In-memory channelId -> ChannelSession hot cache over SQLite history; rehydrates ADK window on creation up to session.windowSize with idle TTL.

nodes.label: Session History Rehydration
nodes.rationale: SQLite is canonical for durable bot state; restart does not erase retained history. Hot cache is rehydrated up to session.windowSize.

nodes.label: Roka Agent (ADK)
nodes.rationale: 4-layer prompt system embodying Maniwa Roka, rule-based tone detection, prompt assembler, and gemini-3.5-flash-lite backend via Google ADK.

nodes.label: Gemini API Backend
nodes.rationale: gemini-3.5-flash-lite model with 1M context window, bound by 15 RPM, 250K TPM, and 500 RPD rate limits.

nodes.label: SQLite Canonical Persistence
nodes.rationale: better-sqlite3 database (data/rokabot.db) is canonical store for durable history, memory claims, reminders, scores, and metrics.

nodes.label: session_history SQLite Table
nodes.rationale: Stores channel messages, display name, role, content, timestamp, and optional user identity fields.

nodes.label: Telemetry Failure Marker Privacy Contract
nodes.rationale: response_events.failure_marker stores the raw finishReason or errorCode token only (e.g. SAFETY), never message text, preserving user privacy.

nodes.label: SQLite Durable Tables Ecosystem
nodes.rationale: Covers reminders, user_names, game_scores, gacha_collection, gacha_daily, buddy, and monitored_channels stored in SQLite.

nodes.label: Runtime Environment
nodes.rationale: TypeScript ^5.8 ES2022 target with Node16 modules running on Node.js 24 Alpine ARM64 for Raspberry Pi 5.

nodes.label: Docker Multi-Stage Deployment
nodes.rationale: Multi-stage Docker build producing ~150MB node:24-alpine ARM64 image; Compose enforces 512MB RAM cap and JSON file log rotation on Raspberry Pi 5.

nodes.label: WindowMessage Model
nodes.rationale: Represents a single message in the FIFO window: role, displayName, content, timestamp.

nodes.label: ChannelSession Model
nodes.rationale: Per-channel session state: channelId, messages FIFO cache, idleTimer handle, and lastActivity timestamp.

nodes.label: RateLimiterConfig Model
nodes.rationale: Dual rate limiter configuration specifying rolling minute max requests (rpm: 15) and daily turns (rpd: 500).

nodes.label: AssemblerInput Model
nodes.rationale: Prompt assembler input: detected tone, recent participant display names, time-of-day hour, and addressed displayName.

nodes.label: ToneKey Model
nodes.rationale: Enum of 12 detected conversation tones: playful, sincere, domestic, flustered, curious, annoyed, tender, confident, nostalgic, mischievous, sleepy, competitive.

nodes.label: Tone Detection Precedence
nodes.rationale: detectTone is first-match-wins over TONE_PATTERNS declaration order, not table row order; behavioral precedence pinned by tests.

nodes.label: Claims Memory System
nodes.rationale: SQLite-backed, guild-scoped typed claims replacing all-facts retrieval when memory.claimsBackend is enabled, with legacy path as rollback.

nodes.label: Claim Deduplication Constraint (idx_memory_claim_dedup)
nodes.rationale: Unique constraint on (guild_id, subject_user_id, predicate, value) enforcing claim uniqueness in SQLite.

nodes.label: Memory Claim FTS5 Mirror
nodes.rationale: FTS5 virtual-table mirror of active memory_claim rows maintained automatically by insert, update, and delete triggers.

nodes.label: Claim Lifecycle Management
nodes.rationale: Lifecycle candidate -> active -> superseded -> rejected. Single-cardinality predicate activation supersedes prior active claims and sets superseded_by.

nodes.label: needs_review Quarantine Invariant
nodes.rationale: Claims flagged with needs_review are excluded from general retrieval and selected only as anchors for their own subject_user_id to prevent cross-context leaks.

nodes.label: Claim Retention and Capacity Limits
nodes.rationale: Prunes unpinned claims when last_seen_at exceeds memory.claimRetentionDays (90d) and caps active claims at memory.maxActiveClaimsPerUser (20) by salience.

nodes.label: Bounded Memory Retrieval Contract
nodes.rationale: Retrieval bounded to memory.maxClaimsPerTurn (10) and ~350 tokens (memory.retrievalTokenBudget). Reserves memory.speakerMinShare (0.5) for speaker anchors.

nodes.label: Memory Extraction Pipeline
nodes.rationale: Candidate gate -> persisted extraction_queue -> per-guild round-robin scheduler -> batched extractor -> transactional assert/retract.

nodes.label: Guild Tenancy and DM Isolation
nodes.rationale: Claims are strictly guild-scoped; non-guild channels are shaped dm:<channelId>. No shared global tenant exists; assertWritableGuild throws on it.

nodes.label: Prompt-Assembly Retrieval Invariant
nodes.rationale: Retrieval runs once in generateResponse while assembling _systemPrompt; beforeModelCallback reads only assembled state and never triggers DB reads.

nodes.label: Claims Backend Flag and Rollback
nodes.rationale: memory.claimsBackend defaults to true; setting MEMORY_CLAIMS_BACKEND=false rolls back to legacy user_memory all-facts path.

nodes.label: Obsidian Vault Export Technical Contract
nodes.rationale: exportVault() is an offline read-only export writing one note per (guild_id, subject_user_id) with YAML frontmatter, wikilinks, and path containment guards.

nodes.label: InteractionCreate Slash Command Contract
nodes.rationale: Handles /ask slash commands via deferReply() -> process -> editReply(response).

nodes.label: MessageCreate Mention/Reply Contract
nodes.rationale: Filters non-bot mentions and bot replies; handles typing indicators and response via message.reply().

nodes.label: Installation and Context Policy
nodes.rationale: Commands registered globally with explicit install context (GuildInstall/UserInstall) and interaction context. UserInstall has no gateway stream.

nodes.label: System Prompt Token Cap Guard
nodes.rationale: System prompt (4 assembled layers) is size-capped by MAX_SYSTEM_PROMPT_TOKENS as a change-detection gate, not a latency budget.

nodes.label: Gemini Safety Settings Contract
nodes.rationale: Four harm categories set to gemini.safetyThreshold (default OFF); PROHIBITED_CONTENT, SPII, and BLOCKLIST are server-side and trigger static safety deflection.

nodes.label: Gemini Failure Taxonomy
nodes.rationale: Classifies failures into transient_http, network, empty_text, safety, session_corrupt, recitation, quota_exhausted, terminal, and extraction_failure.

nodes.label: Gemini Retry Loop & Deadline Budget
nodes.rationale: Up to 2 retries with 1s exponential base backoff + full jitter, capped at ~12s accumulated backoff and gemini.turnDeadlineMs wall-clock budget.

nodes.label: Session Corrupt Recovery Mechanism
nodes.rationale: When Gemini 400 reports function-call following user turn, destroys ADK session and rehydrates it from SQLite before a single retry.

nodes.label: Steered Safety Regeneration
nodes.rationale: Safety blocks trigger one-shot steered regeneration for in-character redirect; falls back to static deflection: Ehh... let not get into that one~.

nodes.label: Spent Day vs Spent Minute Classification
nodes.rationale: Separates 429 quota exhaustion: RequestsPerDay does not recover until midnight Pacific (deflect at once); RequestsPerMinute recovers in seconds. Ignores misleading 39s retryDelay.
nodes.norm_label: spent day vs spent minute classification

nodes.label: RPM Budget Accounting and Floor Priority
nodes.rationale: Live retries require remainingRpm >= 2; background extraction requires remainingRpm >= 3. Live user traffic always wins over background extraction.
nodes.norm_label: rpm budget accounting and floor priority

nodes.label: Turn Call Reservation Guard (#167)
nodes.rationale: Turn reserves gemini.maxLlmCalls (4) slots at ceiling and releases unused in finally; closes gap where 15 turns became up to 60 requests against 15 RPM quota.

nodes.label: Dual Window Bounding Strategy
nodes.rationale: Exact sliding window array where exactness is cheap (rateLimiter RPM count); continuous draining bucket with halved knob where it is not (tokenBudget TPM).

nodes.label: Global In-Flight Attachment Byte Budget
nodes.rationale: Bounds concurrent attachment downloads to discord.maxInFlightAttachmentBytes (32MB) to prevent 4.7x RSS memory blowup and container SIGKILL on RPi 5.

nodes.label: Attachment Types and Ceilings Contract
nodes.rationale: Image 4MB (sharp), Document 10MB, Audio 8MB, Video 10MB (low resolution). Types declared in attachments.ts and ceilings in attachmentLimits.ts.

nodes.label: Media Prefixing and Streaming Abort
nodes.rationale: Oversized media bounded by prefix if container survives cutting (MP3 frames, ISOBMFF with moov before mdat); readWithinLimit cancels stream at ceiling.

nodes.label: Components V2 Media Extraction
nodes.rationale: Extracts Thumbnail (11), MediaGallery (12), File (13) components from Components V2 payloads; unreadable or missing content_type increments unsupportedCount.

nodes.label: SSRF Guarded Media URL Resolution
nodes.rationale: attachment_url resolves user-provided hosts with 2s HEAD and 15s body timeouts, size ceilings, and private address filtering.

nodes.label: Attachment Token Admission Control
nodes.rationale: countTokens probes attachments before request and refuses turns exceeding gemini.maxAttachmentTokens; skips flat 1,089-token images; video allowance removed.

nodes.label: Per-Minute Token Budget (TPM Guard)
nodes.rationale: Global rolling-minute token bucket draining continuously; maxTokensPerMinute knob capped at 125,000 (half 250k TPM) to defend against burst drain arithmetic.

nodes.label: Attachment History Stripping
nodes.rationale: WindowedSessionService.stripAttachmentBytes replaces inlineData with text markers post-turn; prevents ~11.5MB heap retention per attachment and re-billing across turns.

nodes.label: ADK Error Delivery Constraint
nodes.rationale: ADK yields errors as runner events rather than throwing; createLlmResponse maps finishReason to errorCode and drops safetyRatings, leaving only coarse finishReason.

nodes.label: Maniwa Roka Character Embodiment
nodes.rationale: Embodying Maniwa Roka from Senren*Banka as an observant, affectionate, teasing onee-san Discord chatbot.

nodes.label: Discord Platform and Gateway
nodes.rationale: Discord bot interface using discord.js v14 with Guilds, GuildMessages, and MessageContent intents.

nodes.label: Gemini API and Google ADK
nodes.rationale: Primary LLM backend using Gemini 3.5 Flash Lite via Google ADK TypeScript for conversational turns.

nodes.label: Tavily Search API
nodes.rationale: External search API funding web search queries with domain citations.

nodes.label: Jikan Unofficial MyAnimeList API
nodes.rationale: Fetches anime metadata and airing schedules without consuming LLM slots.

nodes.label: SQLite Storage Engine
nodes.rationale: Durable SQLite database via better-sqlite3 for session history, memory claims, reminders, and games.

nodes.label: Discord Slash Commands
nodes.rationale: Server-wide slash commands (/ask, /gacha, /hangman, /shiritori, /anime, /remind, /stats) registered with Discord.

nodes.label: Trigger Surfaces (Mentions, Replies, Keywords)
nodes.rationale: Conversation triggers beyond slash commands: direct mentions, replies to Roka messages, and name-keyword detections.

nodes.label: In-Conversation Tool Rituals
nodes.rationale: Tools invoked implicitly by Roka during dialogue, phrased in the UI as shrine rituals with relative timestamps.

nodes.label: Shrine Ritual Tool Footer
nodes.rationale: Reply footer noting up to 3 rituals (dice, coin, time, weather, anime, reminders) and up to 3 source domains for web search.

nodes.label: Last 30 Days Stats Views
nodes.rationale: Four fixed non-overlapping Last 30 Days views (Overview, Mood, Memory, Nerd) without window selector to simplify analytics.

nodes.label: SQLite-Backed Games Suite
nodes.rationale: Buddy Pets, Hangman, and Shiritori mini-games maintaining state and leaderboards in SQLite.

nodes.label: Attachment Ceilings by Media Type
nodes.rationale: Image (4MB), PDF (10MB), audio (8MB), video (10MB) ceilings derived from upload transfer time against gemini.timeout, not Pi memory.

nodes.label: One Attachment Per Turn Constraint
nodes.rationale: Fairness constraint: global in-flight byte budget is shared across all channels; multiple attachments per turn would starve others.

nodes.label: Oversized Media Truncation Policy
nodes.rationale: Oversized files truncated to ceiling only for container formats surviving truncation (e.g. streamable MP4 with moov at start); others refused.

nodes.label: In-Character Attachment Failure Notices
nodes.rationale: Distinct notices for retrieval failure vs oversized media prevents agent from searching web on user filename and hallucinating contents.

nodes.label: Attachment URL SSRF and Type Validation
nodes.rationale: HEAD request determines content type without trusting path; checks resolved IP against private address patterns across redirects.
nodes.norm_label: attachment url ssrf and type validation

nodes.label: Rich Message Perception
nodes.rationale: Reads forwarded messages, embeds, polls, stickers, and Components V2 files beyond simple attachments.

nodes.label: Message Processing Pipeline
nodes.rationale: Sequential flow: trigger -> rate/concurrency guards -> session window -> tone detection -> prompt assembly -> ADK -> Gemini -> Components V2 reply.

nodes.label: Per-Channel Concurrency Guard
nodes.rationale: Strictly permits one active response per channel to prevent overlapping turns and state corruption.

nodes.label: Four-Stage Admission Guards Ladder
nodes.rationale: Ordered admission sequence: 1) advisory rate-limit check, 2) token budget check, 3) call-slot reservation, 4) in-flight byte-budget reservation.

nodes.label: Zero-Call Slot Optimization
nodes.rationale: Slash commands /anime and /remind execute without reserving or consuming Gemini LLM call slots.

nodes.label: HTTP 429 Classification
nodes.rationale: Separates spent daily quota from transient rate limits so the bot can deflect on quota exhaustion and backoff on rate limits.

nodes.label: Four-Layer Prompt Assembly
nodes.rationale: Combines core identity, speech patterns, tone variant, and channel context (participants, time, safety envelope) into a size-capped prompt.

nodes.label: Rule-Based Tone Detection
nodes.rationale: Matches recent messages against regex rules across 12 tones with zero LLM cost or latency.

nodes.label: Tone Expression and Accent Mapping
nodes.rationale: Each of the 12 tones maps to a distinct prompt variant, accent color hex code, and expression thumbnail pool.

nodes.label: Discord Components V2 Reply
nodes.rationale: Renders replies with expression thumbnail, accent color styling, and interactive component structure.

nodes.label: Claims-Based Memory Pipeline
nodes.rationale: Passive buffer -> candidate gate -> extraction queue -> per-guild scheduler -> extractor -> claims store -> bounded retriever.

nodes.label: Tenant Memory Isolation
nodes.rationale: Memory claims strictly isolated per tenant (guild, DM, or group chat); facts never cross server or conversation boundaries.

nodes.label: Pinned Claims Exemption
nodes.rationale: Explicit remember_user facts are pinned and exempt from the active-claim ceiling.

nodes.label: Recall Relevance Ranking
nodes.rationale: recall_user tool ranks stored memory claims by semantic relevance to the current turn rather than pure recency.

nodes.label: Obsidian Vault Export
nodes.rationale: Exports SQLite memory claims into read-only Obsidian Markdown vault for desktop viewing, keeping the Pi headless.

nodes.label: Gemini Tunables (config.yml)
nodes.rationale: Tunables including model ID, extractionModel, timeout, maxRetries, safetyThreshold, retryRpmFloor, and turnDeadlineMs.

nodes.label: Rate Limit and Session Tunables
nodes.rationale: Tunables including rateLimit.rpm, rateLimit.rpd, session.ttl, session.windowSize, and session.historyRetentionDays.

nodes.label: Attachment and Budget Tunables
nodes.rationale: Tunables for maxAttachmentTokens, maxTokensPerMinute, and maxInFlightAttachmentBytes.

nodes.label: Memory Configuration Tunables
nodes.rationale: Tunables for bufferSize, extractionInterval, claimsBackend, maxClaimsPerTurn, retrievalTokenBudget, and perGuildGapMs.

nodes.label: .env Secrets Configuration
nodes.rationale: Environment secrets: DISCORD_TOKEN, DISCORD_CLIENT_ID, GEMINI_API_KEY, TAVILY_API_KEY, DEV_GEMINI_API_KEY, ROKABOT_HARNESS_KEY.

nodes.label: Verification and Acceptance Gates
nodes.rationale: Verification gate is npm test && npm run test:perf; npm run typecheck type-checks tests; npm run test:live gates prompt changes.

nodes.label: Live Model Benchmark Gate (npm run test:live)
nodes.rationale: Benchmarks live model tool triggering against recall-user, search-web, remember-user JSONL sets with precision and per-tool recall floors.
nodes.norm_label: live model benchmark gate (npm run test:live)

nodes.label: Attachment Token Measure Utility (npm run measure)
nodes.rationale: Measures attachment token cost and checks against ceilings without consuming live generate quota.
nodes.norm_label: attachment token measure utility (npm run measure)

nodes.label: Docker Compose Memory Limits
nodes.rationale: mem_limit: 1g and memswap_limit: 1g disable swap entirely to prevent Docker from paging onto the SD card.

nodes.label: Self-Hosted GitHub Actions CI/CD
nodes.rationale: Runner auto-deploys pushes to main; paths-ignore skips documentation to avoid unnecessary container rebuilds.

nodes.label: SSH Access (Ethernet and WiFi)
nodes.rationale: Access via Ethernet static IP (/etc/netplan/50-cloud-init.yaml) or WiFi, with AP isolation caveats on mobile hotspots.

nodes.label: Docker Bot Management Commands
nodes.rationale: Operational commands for live logs, restarting, stopping, building, checking status, and monitoring docker stats.

nodes.label: Pi Network and System Services
nodes.rationale: Netplan networking, dnsmasq DHCP leases, CPU thermal monitoring, and docker daemon journalctl logs.

nodes.label: Self-Hosted Runner Service Operations
nodes.rationale: Polls GitHub outbound; on main push runs git pull -> docker compose build -> health check. No automatic rollback on failure.

nodes.label: SQLite Database Administration
nodes.rationale: Direct CLI queries via sqlite3 into ~/rokabot/data/rokabot.db across user_memory, reminders, session_history, games, and diagnostics.

nodes.label: user_memory Table Operations
nodes.rationale: Inspecting, querying, and deleting facts per user in user_memory.

nodes.label: reminders Table Operations
nodes.rationale: Querying pending reminders (due_at with +8h timezone offset) and deleting delivered/stale reminders.

nodes.label: session_history Table Operations
nodes.rationale: Inspecting recent messages, per-channel counts, and clearing channel history.

nodes.label: buddy and gacha_daily Tables
nodes.rationale: Querying hatched buddies, stats_json, user collection counts, and daily hatch streaks.

nodes.label: game_scores Table Operations
nodes.rationale: Leaderboard aggregation by game and recent score logging.

nodes.label: failure_diagnostics Forensics
nodes.rationale: Stores triggering message verbatim on fallback/deflection with short retention (metrics.diagnosticsRetentionHours, default 72h) for forensic analysis.

nodes.label: Context De-escalation Safety Ladder
nodes.rationale: De-escalates carried context rung-by-rung upon safety blocks; rescued turns never reach failure_diagnostics table.

nodes.label: Database Wipe and Reinitialization
nodes.rationale: Stopping container before deleting .db, -wal, and -shm files enables clean automatic recreation on restart without locks.

nodes.label: Load-Bearing bot Scope Requirement
nodes.rationale: Guild install must request both bot and applications.commands; omitting bot creates half-alive ghost install without gateway events.

nodes.label: API-Derived Discord Permissions
nodes.rationale: Permissions derived strictly from code API calls: View Channels, Send Messages, Read Message History, Add Reactions, Attach Files.

nodes.label: Pre-Granted Embed Links Permission
nodes.rationale: Embed Links granted but unused today; pre-granted for issue #19 hyperlink footnotes to avoid future re-authorization.

nodes.label: Reminder Channel Delivery Permission
nodes.rationale: Reminders deliver to originating channel first before falling back to DM, requiring guild Send Messages permission.

nodes.label: No Build-Time Permission Pin Decision
nodes.rationale: Test asserting permissions was rejected because testing code grep against code grep gives false confidence while Portal remains out-of-tree.

nodes.label: Problem Statement
nodes.rationale: Addresses lack of personality depth, speech patterns, and multi-turn context in existing chatbots for small Discord anime/VN communities.

nodes.label: Project Objectives
nodes.rationale: Establishes authentic character interaction, natural conversation flow, resource efficiency (RPi 5, Flash Lite limits), graceful degradation, and ADK extensibility.

nodes.label: Target Users
nodes.rationale: Identifies Server Members chatting in-character, Server Owner (ZJ) deploying on RPi 5 with low maintenance, and Casual Chatters mentioning Roka.

nodes.label: User Workflow Overview
nodes.rationale: Defines the end-to-end request lifecycle from slash command or mention to rate limiting, session building, prompt assembly, Gemini call, and chunked response.

nodes.label: FR-1: Slash Command Interaction
nodes.rationale: Single /ask surface answers both conversation and lookups, replacing separate /chat and /search commands.

nodes.label: FR-2: Mention/Reply Interaction
nodes.rationale: Detects @mention and replies to bot messages while ignoring bots and own messages; shows typing indicator.

nodes.label: FR-3: Per-Channel Conversational Memory
nodes.rationale: Sliding FIFO window of last 10 messages with 5-minute idle TTL maintained per channel in memory.

nodes.label: FR-4: Layered Personality Prompts
nodes.rationale: Assembles 4 layers (Core Identity, Speech Patterns, Conversation Tone, Channel Awareness) within token cap.

nodes.label: FR-5: Tone Detection
nodes.rationale: Rule-based keyword detector selects flustered, sincere, domestic, or default playful tone at zero LLM cost.

nodes.label: FR-6: Rate Limiting
nodes.rationale: Dual rate limiter (sliding window RPM + midnight reset RPD) prevents quota exhaustion with in-character declines.

nodes.label: FR-7: Error Handling
nodes.rationale: All API errors (429, 500/503 retry, timeout) surface as in-character decline/fallback messages, never raw errors.

nodes.label: FR-8: Response Formatting
nodes.rationale: Splits long responses at newline or word boundaries under maxMessageLength with ~500ms sequential pacing.

nodes.label: FR-9: Docker Deployment
nodes.rationale: Multi-stage Dockerfile on ARM64 node:24-alpine with non-root user, memory capping, and log rotation.

nodes.label: FR-10: Graceful Shutdown
nodes.rationale: Cleans up timers, destroys Discord connection on SIGTERM/SIGINT with 5-second forced exit timeout.

nodes.label: Multimodal Intake Research
nodes.rationale: Research and design for issue #100 letting Roka see video, hear audio, and read documents without premature implementation.

nodes.label: PDF Intake Recommendation
nodes.rationale: Ship now with 10 MB cap; rides existing pipeline, requires MIME routing to skip sharp image processing.

nodes.label: Audio Intake Recommendation
nodes.rationale: Ship second with 8 MB cap (~5 min at 128 kbps); blocked on global in-flight byte budget to prevent container OOM.

nodes.label: Video Low Resolution Recommendation
nodes.rationale: Ship last with 10 MB cap (~60s); pins low media resolution to stay within 250K TPM ceiling; blocked on streaming size guard.

nodes.label: Video Default Resolution Declined
nodes.rationale: Declined: 300 tokens/sec exhausts 250K TPM in 10 one-minute clips, costing 3x low resolution for zero benefit at small sizes.

nodes.label: Container Memory Cap Correction
nodes.rationale: Container was capped at 512 MB (not 8 GB host); raised to 1 GB mem_limit with memswap_limit 1 GB to disable SD card paging.

nodes.label: ALLOWED_IMAGE_TYPES Consolidation
nodes.rationale: Issue #101 consolidated duplicate image types into single declaration in src/discord/attachments.ts.

nodes.label: Flash-Lite Modality Verification
nodes.rationale: Verified gemini-3.5-flash-lite supports text, image, video, audio, and PDF natively with 1M input window; no model switch needed.

nodes.label: Inline Data vs Files API Decision
nodes.rationale: Use inlineData under 20 MB ceiling; excludes Files API to avoid upload round trips, storage lifetime management, and extra hot-path failure modes.
nodes.norm_label: inline data vs files api decision

nodes.label: Free-Tier TPM Ceiling Measurement
nodes.rationale: Provoked 429 confirms 250,000 input tokens/minute quotaId GenerateContentInputTokensPerModelPerMinute-FreeTier per model.

nodes.label: PDF Token Cost Measurement
nodes.rationale: Empirically measured at 560 tokens/page regardless of content; corrects doc figure of 258 tok/page; single doc can trip TPM.

nodes.label: Attachment History Stripping
nodes.rationale: Attachment bytes stripped from session history after turn to prevent 20x re-billing across 10-turn window.

nodes.label: Silent SIGKILL Risk
nodes.rationale: Kernel exit 137 drops process with empty stdout/stderr and auto-restarts silently; requires defensive design margin.

nodes.label: SD Card Swap Thrashing Resolution
nodes.rationale: Setting memswap_limit equal to mem_limit disables SD card swap paging, preventing 63s turnDeadlineMs timeouts and SD wear.

nodes.label: 4.7x RSS Attachment Multiplier
nodes.rationale: Attachment payload is copied 4 times (arrayBuffer 1x, Buffer.from 1x, base64 1.33x, JSON 1.33x) totaling 4.66x RSS overhead.

nodes.label: V8 Heap Limit Bypass by Buffers
nodes.rationale: Node.js Buffers live outside V8 heap (259MB/560MB limits), allocating container RSS directly so kernel OOM kills before JS OOM throws.
nodes.norm_label: v8 heap limit bypass by buffers

nodes.label: Concurrency Binding Constraint
nodes.rationale: Per-channel concurrency guard has no global ceiling; K busy channels can hold K concurrent 4.7x payloads, threatening SIGKILL.

nodes.label: Global In-Flight Byte Budget
nodes.rationale: Enforces 32 MB total concurrent in-flight attachment bytes across all channels, bounding worst-case RSS to ~206 MB (20% of 1 GB).

nodes.label: Streaming Size Guard
nodes.rationale: Running byte counter cancels reader mid-transfer to protect against missing Content-Length headers buffering full video in memory.

nodes.label: Upload Latency Bounds
nodes.rationale: At measured 2.5 MB/s uplink, 10 MB takes 4.0s (fits 20s attempt with 6s spare), while 20 MB leaves zero retry headroom in 63s turnDeadlineMs.

nodes.label: Byte Cap as Duration Proxy
nodes.rationale: Enforcing true duration requires ffprobe and decoding, consuming memory to measure; byte cap is the enforceable proxy protecting the host.

nodes.label: Recommended Attachment Caps
nodes.rationale: Caps: 10 MB PDF (latency-bound), 8 MB audio (~5 min), 10 MB low-res video (~60s), 32 MB total in-flight across channels.

nodes.label: Memory Limit (1g)
nodes.rationale: Host has 8 GB and nothing else competes; 512m left no margin once an attachment is in flight.

nodes.label: Memory Swap Limit (1g)
nodes.rationale: Must equal mem_limit — this is memory+swap combined, so equal values mean no swap at all.

nodes.label: CI Paths Ignore Filter
nodes.rationale: Skips CI and deploy runs when only documentation (*.md, docs/**) or editor settings (.claude/**) change, avoiding unnecessary test runs and container restarts.

nodes.label: CI Dummy Secrets
nodes.rationale: Supplies dummy DISCORD_TOKEN, DISCORD_CLIENT_ID, and GEMINI_API_KEY so configuration validation passes during test execution without exposing secrets.

nodes.label: gemini.timeout (20000ms)
nodes.rationale: API request timeout covers initial Gemini -> tool -> second Gemini round; ~2x measured p95 of 9801ms (n=78), with headroom over 13613ms worst tool chain, admitting two retries inside turnDeadlineMs.

nodes.label: gemini.maxAttachmentTokens (50000)
nodes.rationale: Max measured token cost of turn attachments before refusal. PDF ~560 tokens/page; 50k is 1/5th of 250k TPM ceiling, admitting 3 max audio clips while refusing a 200-page PDF.

nodes.label: gemini.maxTokensPerMinute (125000)
nodes.rationale: 125k TPM is half the 250k TPM ceiling (#125); continuously-draining bucket admits capacity AND rate in one rolling minute, bounding worst burst to 250k.

nodes.label: gemini.turnDeadlineMs (63000ms)
nodes.rationale: 3 attempts x 20s timeout + 3s worst-case jitter; keeps gemini.timeout calibrated at measured 20s bound.

nodes.label: discord.maxInFlightAttachmentBytes (33554432)
nodes.rationale: 32 MB ceiling across all channels; each byte costs ~4.7x in RSS, holding worst-case residency near 20% of 1g container limit. Allows three concurrent 10 MB downloads.

nodes.label: Per-Channel Concurrency Guard
nodes.rationale: Serializes requests to 1 active request per channel to prevent race conditions, interleaved responses, and session state corruption.

nodes.label: Rule-Based Tone Detection
nodes.rationale: Zero-LLM cost tone detection using pattern-matching rules avoids additional latency and API token expenditures.

nodes.label: SQLite Canonical Storage
nodes.rationale: SQLite (data/rokabot.db via better-sqlite3) is canonical for session history, memory claims, reminders, games, and metrics; in-memory window is a hot cache rehydrated on restart.

nodes.label: RPM Binding Rate Limit
nodes.rationale: RPM rather than RPD is the binding rate limit under free-tier quotas and burst usage patterns.

nodes.label: System Prompt Token Cap
nodes.rationale: MAX_SYSTEM_PROMPT_TOKENS enforced in tests/harness/tokens.test.ts exists for change/regression detection, not latency optimization.

nodes.label: Two-Tier Typecheck Gate
nodes.rationale: npm run build type-checks src/ only; npm run typecheck uses tsconfig.test.json to type-check both src/ and tests/.

nodes.label: Biome and Prettier Formatting
nodes.rationale: Biome owns TS/JS linting, formatting, and single-quote preference (double quotes for apostrophes); Prettier formats md, yml, and json.

nodes.label: Main Branch PR CI Gate
nodes.rationale: main is PR-only; PR can merge only once test check passes in deploy workflow; squash merge required, auto-merge and admin merge forbidden.
